description: SAHAY-AI external dataset registry. Metadata only: no raw data, no sample text, no machine-specific path. Files live at <SAHAY_DATASETS_ROOT>/<local_relative_path>, outside Git. A downloaded file is never approved automatically; review states change only by a human edit reviewed like any other change.

datasets.name: Dreaddit: A Reddit Dataset for Stress Analysis in Social Media
datasets.sahay_purpose: Proposal only (EXT-105, P2): possible English baseline for a generic 'stress expressed in text' signal. Not a crisis, danger, vulnerability, diagnosis or SVI label source.
datasets.download_source: http://www.cs.columbia.edu/~eturcan/data/dreaddit.zip (as stated in the paper and the first author's page)
datasets.publisher: Elsbeth Turcan and Kathleen McKeown, Columbia University (paper published by ACL)
datasets.citation: Elsbeth Turcan and Kathy McKeown. 2019. Dreaddit: A Reddit Dataset for Stress Analysis in Social Media. In Proceedings of the Tenth International Workshop on Health Text Mining and Information Analysis (LOUHI 2019), pages 97-107. doi:10.18653/v1/D19-6213
datasets.research_only_restrictions: No dataset licence or terms found in the paper, the ACL Anthology page or the author's page (checked 2026-09-11). The ACL Anthology CC BY 4.0 notice covers the paper, not the dataset. Underlying posts are Reddit content subject to Reddit's own terms.
datasets.attribution_requirements: Cite the paper (above). Any further requirement unknown.
datasets.consent_statement: None published. Posts were collected from public subreddits with PRAW; labels from Amazon Mechanical Turk. No privacy, anonymisation, consent or ethics-review statement found in the paper.
privacy_risks: Real, first-person Reddit posts from abuse, domestic-violence, PTSD, anxiety, financial-hardship and relationship communities: highly sensitive personal narratives.
Public posts can often be re-identified by searching their text; usernames or other identifiers may be present (not inspected).
Must never be printed, logged, sent to an external service, committed or shown to a victim.
datasets.demographics: Not published. Reddit users (predominantly English-speaking and not representative of Indian helpline callers); MTurk annotators, demographics not published.
datasets.label_definitions: Binary per segment: stress vs no stress, where stress is the author expressing a state of mental or emotional strain or tension from adverse circumstances with negative affect. At least five MTurk annotators per segment; Fleiss kappa 0.47 (moderate). Not crisis, not immediate danger, not vulnerability, not a diagnosis.
datasets.splits: Paper: 2,838 train and 715 test labelled segments (3,553 total) from 3,000 posts; about 187k unlabelled posts collected. Local archive: 2 CSV members (train, test), as listed in its central directory.
datasets.contamination_risk: Low overlap with the fictional SAHAY corpora (different domain and language), but any future use must be registered before viewing; once samples are viewed during rule development they cannot be holdout.
limitations: English Reddit posts, not Hindi or Hinglish helpline speech.
Generic stress, not caste-atrocity victimisation, crisis or danger.
unresolved_questions: What licence or terms, if any, govern the dataset itself? None found in authoritative sources.
Does use and redistribution of Reddit-derived text comply with Reddit's terms for this project?
Were usernames or other identifiers removed from the released CSVs? Not inspected (content not read).
No approved external decision: EXT-105 is PROPOSED in docs/EXTERNAL_DECISIONS.md, yet a copy was downloaded locally.

datasets.name: EmoInHindi: A Multi-label Emotion and Intensity Annotated Dataset in Hindi for Emotion Recognition in Dialogues
datasets.sahay_purpose: Proposal only: possible Hindi TEXT dialogue resource for studying emotion vocabulary in counselling-style conversations. It is text, not audio, so it cannot inform D4 (acoustic distress).
datasets.download_source: Request form linked from https://www.iitp.ac.in/~ai-nlp-ml/resources.html (IIT Patna AI-NLP-ML group)
datasets.publisher: AI-NLP-ML Group, IIT Patna (Singh, Priya, Firdaus, Ekbal, Bhattacharyya); paper published by ELRA at LREC 2022
datasets.citation: Gopendra Vikram Singh, Priyanshu Priya, Mauajama Firdaus, Asif Ekbal and Pushpak Bhattacharyya. 2022. EmoInHindi: A Multi-label Emotion and Intensity Annotated Dataset in Hindi for Emotion Recognition in Dialogues. In Proceedings of the Thirteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2022), pages 5829-5837.
datasets.licence_name: IIT Patna AI-NLP-ML resource terms: research purposes only, citation required (no named licence)
datasets.research_only_restrictions: Publisher page: by downloading, users agree to use the resources for research purposes only and to cite the paper. The arXiv CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and ACL Anthology CC BY 4.0 notices cover the paper, not the dataset.
datasets.consent_statement: Dialogues were created Wizard-of-Oz style by trained annotators (not real victims), per the paper; no explicit consent or ethics-approval statement found.
privacy_risks: Simulated counselling dialogues about crime victims (domestic violence, harassment, fraud, cybercrime): sensitive topics even if fictional personas.
Whether any real personal data appears is not verified (content not read).
Must never be printed, logged, sent to an external service, committed or shown to a victim.
datasets.demographics: Not published for annotators or personas.
datasets.label_definitions: Multi-label, 16 emotion classes (Anticipation, Confident, Hopeful, Anger, Sad, Joy, Compassion, Fear, Disgusted, Annoyed, Grateful, Impressed, Apprehensive, Surprised, Guilty, Neutral) with intensity 0 (neutral) to 3 per utterance. Emotion labels, not vulnerability, crisis or clinical labels.
datasets.splits: Paper: 1,814 dialogues, 44,247 utterances; 80% train (20% of which used for validation), 20% test. Local archive: one CSV and one Markdown file in an EmoInHindi/ folder; whether the CSV carries a split column is not verified.
datasets.contamination_risk: Topical overlap with SAHAY fixtures (crime-victim counselling). Any sample viewed during rule development can no longer be holdout; register the viewing in ml/eval/contamination.py.
limitations: Text only: no audio, so it says nothing about acoustic distress (D4).
Wizard-of-Oz simulated dialogues, not real helpline calls.
Emotion labels are not vulnerability or crisis labels.
unresolved_questions: Was the local copy obtained through the publisher's request form, accepting the research-only terms? Not recorded.
Is redistribution (including derived text in reports or model artefacts) permitted? Not stated.
Script of the text (Devanagari, romanised or mixed) is not verified; content was not read.
No external decision (EXT entry) exists for this dataset in docs/EXTERNAL_DECISIONS.md.
Does 'research purposes only' cover a government helpline prototype? Needs a human licence review.
